changelog:
- Center Command Input Card: Embedded modern 14dp squircle Command Input Card on the Start Page right above the shortcuts and feature buttons with search engine switcher, voice search, tabs counter, and options menu.
- Dynamic Web Toolbar: Seamlessly switches to bottom/top floating bar upon searching or navigating to web pages.
- Desktop Preview Support: Full standalone interactivity for desktop testing harness and WebEngine.
- Modern SVG Feature Buttons: Squircle actions for Favorites, History, AdShield, and Settings.
